rule: Manic symptoms may be accompanied but appear for a relatively short period compared to the total duration of the delusion; does not meet diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia.
additional_requirements: Functioning is not markedly impaired apart from the impact of the delusion(s) or its ramifications

rule: Meets diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia, and both delusions and manic symptoms are accompanied for a long term. There is a period where delusions persist for at least 2 weeks without manic symptoms.
additional_requirements: psychotic_symptoms and manic_episode occur concurrently
manic_episode is present for the majority of the total duration of the active and residual portions of the illness
delusions_and_hallucinations occur for 2 or more weeks in the absence of a major mood episode
Functioning is not markedly impaired apart from the impact of the delusion(s) or its ramifications
